assertions.name: N_l_eq_84_is_an_UNSOURCED_FIGURE
assertions.source: no manifest declares a producer, the one named witness does not carry the number, and the only counting code is a deprecated heuristic capped at 3. So the two reproduction attempts on this branch were measured against a figure nothing derives, and their failure is NOT evidence against their readings. NOT claimed: that 84 is wrong -- an exhaustive enumeration may have been run and its result recorded by hand. Claimed only: the corpus contains nothing that reproduces it, so it cannot be checked and a mismatch against it cannot be interpreted. Same class as the neutron NF table
